name: IIT Bombay Standard Pattern (IITB Semester)
description: IIT Bombay semester system — 100 marks total, 50% mid-semester (IA) + 50% end-semester (ESE). 10-point letter grade system (AP/AA/AB/BB/BC/CC/CD/DD/FR). SPI per semester, CPI cumulative. Credits-based (6-12 credits per subject).

in_semester.name: Mid Semester Examination (IA)
in_semester.notes: IA = 50% of total marks (typically: mid-semester exam ~30%, quizzes/assignments/labs ~20%). Varies by instructor.

instructions: Answer all questions. The paper covers the full syllabus.
Neat diagrams must be drawn wherever necessary.
Figures to the right indicate full marks.

question_structure.description: Comprehensive end-semester examination covering all topics taught in the semester. Typically 8-10 questions with internal choice. Individual instructors may vary the format.
